description: Exide Pakistan Limited manufactures and sells batteries, battery chemicals and acid, and supplies solar energy solutions. It was incorporated in 1953 in association with Chloride Group Plc of the United Kingdom and listed on the Karachi Stock Exchange, now the Pakistan Stock Exchange, in 1982.
headOffice: A-44, Hill Street, off Manghopir Road, S.I.T.E., Karachi, Pakistan
